ss.again: Your school asks you to sign in again.
ss.stillIn: You’re signed out of Darsi. You may still be signed in to {school} on this device.
ss.testSub: Your school’s Darsi admin asked you to try signing in. Nothing is created and you won’t be signed in: they only see whether it worked.
ss.testSpent: This test link was already used or has expired. Ask your school’s Darsi admin for a new one.
ss.rf.sso-off: Signing in through a school is switched off on Darsi for now. Sign in with your email or username, or try again later.
ss.rf.sso-no-school: We couldn’t find this school’s sign-in on Darsi, or it isn’t switched on. Check the link with your school.
ss.rf.sso-org-inactive: Your school’s Darsi account isn’t active at the moment. Ask your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-state: This sign-in expired or was already used. Start again.
ss.rf.sso-origin: This sign-in has to start on Darsi’s own page or your school’s Darsi address. Open it there and try again.
ss.rf.sso-provider: Your school’s sign-in page didn’t let you through. Try again, or ask your school’s IT team.
ss.rf.sso-token: Darsi couldn’t check what your school’s sign-in sent back. Try again. If it keeps happening, tell your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-issuer: The answer didn’t come from your school’s sign-in. Start again. If it keeps happening, tell your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-domain: This account isn’t one your school lets into Darsi. Sign in with your school account, not a personal one.
ss.rf.sso-email: Your school’s sign-in didn’t confirm your email address. Ask your school’s IT team, or sign in another way.
ss.rf.sso-other-org: This account belongs to another organization on Darsi. Sign in the usual way.
ss.rf.sso-staff: Darsi’s platform admins can’t use a school’s sign-in. Sign in with your own login.
ss.rf.sso-disabled: Your school’s Darsi admin has blocked this sign-in. Ask them about it.
ss.rf.sso-removed: Your school removed you from Darsi. Ask your school’s Darsi admin if you should be let back in.
ss.rf.sso-linked: This school account is already connected to another Darsi account. Sign in with that one, or ask your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-connect-first: You already have a Darsi account with this email. Sign in the way you usually do, then open Me and choose Connect school sign-in.
ss.rf.sso-full: Your school has reached the number of people Darsi can add for now. Ask your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-recent: For your safety, confirm it’s you first: sign in again, then try once more.
ss.rf.sso-rate: Too many tries from here. Wait a few minutes and try again.
ss.rf.sso-discovery: Darsi couldn’t reach your school’s sign-in. Try again later.
ss.rf.sso-fields: Something in the request wasn’t right. Start again.
ss.rf.sso-secret: Your school’s sign-in isn’t fully set up on Darsi yet. Ask your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-slug: Darsi couldn’t give your school’s sign-in its address. Try again in a moment.
ss.rf.sso-untested: Your school’s sign-in hasn’t passed its test yet. Ask your school’s Darsi admin.
ss.rf.sso-student-test: Nobody has tested your school’s sign-in with a student account yet.
ss.rf.sso-last-way-in: That would leave the organization with no admin who can sign in without the school. Give an admin a password or Google login first.
ss.rf.sso-key: Signing in through a school isn’t available right now. Try again later, or sign in another way.
ss.rf.sso-signer: Signing in through a school isn’t available right now. Try again later, or sign in another way.
ss.rf.sso-own-login: Sign in with your own Darsi login (email and password, or Google) to do this.
ss.rf.sso-login: This account opens only with the school’s sign-in, so it has no password to reset.
ss.rf.sso-migrate: People are connected to this sign-in. Say whether the new settings are for the same people.
ss.rf.sso-update: Darsi was updated. Reload the page and try again.
ss.rf.network: No connection. Try again when you’re online.
ss.rf.other: Signing in through your school didn’t work. Start again.
ss.lost: This sign-in started in another tab or browser. Go back to the tab where you started, or start again here.
ss.fd.title: Find your school
ss.fd.failed: Couldn’t load the list of schools.
ss.fd.empty: No schools are listed yet. Ask your school for its Darsi sign-in link.
ss.fd.none: No school matches. Check the spelling, or ask your school for its Darsi sign-in link.
ss.td.title: Testing your school’s sign-in
ss.td.busy: Sending the result to your school’s Darsi admin…
ss.td.ok: Thank you. The test reached Darsi, and your school’s Darsi admin can now see the result. You can close this page.
ss.td.student: The test worked: you would join as a student.
ss.td.teacher: The test worked: you would join as a teacher.
ss.td.signin: The test worked: you would be signed in to your Darsi account.
ss.td.refused: The test reached Darsi, but signing in wouldn’t let you in yet:
ss.td.seen: Nothing was created and you weren’t signed in. Your school’s Darsi admin can see this result. You can close this page.
ss.td.failed: The test didn’t work. Your school’s Darsi admin may be able to see why; tell them what this page says.
ss.me.title: School sign-in
ss.me.intro: Your school lets you sign in to Darsi with your school account. Connect it to this account to use it here.
ss.me.confirmFirst: To connect, first confirm it’s you.
ss.me.signAgain: Sign out, sign in again, then come back here to connect.
ss.me.wrongPw: That password isn’t right. Try again.
ss.me.askNoEmail: Connect your school account to this Darsi account?
ss.me.askBody: While connected, whoever runs your school’s sign-in can open this account and change how you sign in to it. Connect only if you trust your school with it. You can disconnect at any time.
ss.me.since: Connected to your school’s sign-in since {date}.
ss.me.disconnectBody: After this you sign in with your own login only. You can connect again at any time.
ss.me.disconnected: Disconnected. Sign in with your own login from now on.
ss.me.viaSchool: You signed in through your school. To change your password or email, or to delete your account, sign in with your own login.
ss.me.emailIntro: This account opens only with your school’s sign-in. Add your own email and a password, so you keep your learning if you leave the school.
ss.me.sent: We sent a link to {email}. Open it, then come back here.
ss.me.notYet: Your email isn’t confirmed yet. Open the link in the email, then try again.
ss.me.done: Done. You can now also sign in with {email} and your password.
ss.me.recent: For your safety, sign in again through your school, then come back here.
ss.me.emailUsed: This email already belongs to another Darsi account. Use another one.
ss.me.emailBad: That doesn’t look like an email address.
ss.me.notAllowed: Your account isn’t allowed to do this right now. Sign out, sign in again, then try once more.
